messages:
alex: Hey team — first day here! Quick map request: who owns what for first-week stuff (repo perms, infra creds, PagerDuty, Dedicated onboarding)? Don’t want to ping the wrong folks.
jenny: Welcome @alex!! :tada: TL;DR: infra creds -> eng-infra, repo perms -> eng-platform, PagerDuty/oncall -> eng-sre. Dedicated onboarding -> product-eng + customer-success for config.
amisspelling: (ignore)
sam: +1 to jenny. For infra creds open a ticket in #help with 'onboard: infra' and tag @eng-infra. Typical turnaround is same day.
mohit: For repo perms, mention the repo path and whether you need write or admin. We usually grant write by default for new hires, admin only with manager approval.
 taylor: For PagerDuty, file an access request at https://redwood.internal/onboarding-roles -> there’s a form that kicks off the PD invite. If you need to be added to an escalation policy immediately ping me or @oncall-bot in #eng-oncall.
alex: Thanks — any clear escalation paths if my env blows up during setup? e.g. who to call for urgent network/VPC issues vs app crashes?
jenny: Network/VPC/credentials -> @eng-infra oncall. App crashes/latency -> @eng-sre oncall. If it's model-serving behavior (wrong model/version) -> @eng-runtime during biz hours, otherwise page eng-sre.
sam: If it’s customer-facing Dedicated infra, also cc @customer-success so they can loop in the account lead. For urgent billing/quotas, ping @finance-ops (we keep a small emergency alias).
oncall-bot: [automated message] If you @mention oncall, please include: service name, region, short impact, and a log snippet. Example:
```
service: inference-prod-eu
impact: 500ms P95 -> 3s, 40% error-rate
logs: /var/logs/inference/2026-03-23/error.log (tail -n 50)
```
mohit: Also FYI — for Dedicated ramp we pair you with a solutions engineer. If you're on an active customer setup say which account and we’ll link you.
alex: Awesome, this is super helpful. One last: who owns the org-level docs for 'who to ask' so I can bookmark?
taylor: That's on the DevEx wiki (owners: @taylor, @jenny). Link: https://redwood.internal/devex/onboarding/who-to-ask. If anything missing ping either of us and we’ll add it.
alex: Perfect, thanks everyone! I’ll open the infra ticket now. :raised_hands:
